_note: `chart` command lines, run through bash splitting + protectShimDollars + the harness CLI + the registered chart tool (lib/chart.mjs). b: chart bar "MAU more than doubled in 2025" --labels "Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4" --values "48000, 61000, 79000, 102000" --subtitle "Monthly active users by quarter, 2025" --highlight Q4 --look clean --palette "#A9BCD6" --accent "#1F5EFF" --radius 4 --bars 0.42 --value_labels on --out mau-2025.svg
